column1: # The patch revisions that changed what a match computes (the simulation),
# oldest first. A game plays a replay only when every game of its recording
# was of the last one's revision or later: a recording of older games plays
# out otherwise in a newer one (session::v026g::replays, read at build time;
# A PR whose change makes a match play out otherwise (an exe patch of the
# game's rules, what a kit or a respawn is, ...) adds the row
# at the end: a PR never knows its revision. The release that ships it is
# that revision: its server takes `next` for its SRP_MIN_PATCH_REVISION
# (the release's own, set at its swap), and release/release.sh writes the
# number in place of `next` in its record. One `next` row at most: a second
# simulation change before the release adds its words to that row.

column2: the Team Deathmatch end (patch 21) and a battery under the floor picked up (patch 23)
patch 31: a kit chosen before the start is played at once where the player stands (#150)
weapon balance 1: weapon damage, armour piercing and rate of fire values, the SVD magazine (5 rounds), and item stamina-regeneration bonuses that now apply (resources.db patch)

patch 38: spotting has no cooldown, and a hit on a battery's body spots it (exe patch, #201); fall damage as in 0.27: gameplay/players/default.player fall_params.fatal_damage 1.5 -> 1 (resources.db patch, content-edit fall-damage-1, #200); the battery pick-up 20 % faster: gameplay/victory_items/default.options states[0].take_time 0.6 -> 0.5 (resources.db patch, content-edit battery-pickup-1)

weapon balance 2: wpn_ak_12 and wpn_ak_12_premium bullet_damage 0.55 -> 0.5, bullet_pierce 0.45 -> 0.35, the premium AK-12 without its reload-time and reliability default modifications (2044, 2094), its silver one (1230) kept; wpn_socom16 bullet_damage 0.8 -> 0.6 (resources.db patch, content-edit weapon-balance-2)

weapon balance 2, retuned (the owner, 2026-10-21): wpn_ak_12 and wpn_ak_12_premium bullet_pierce 0.35 -> 0.4, wpn_socom16 bullet_damage 0.6 -> 0.7 (content-edit weapon-balance-2); wpn_a545 bullet_damage 0.5 -> 0.45, bullet_pierce 0.3 -> 0.25, rounds_per_minute 900 -> 800 (0.28a's nerf); golden weapons 1: the 22 golden weapons (wpn_*_premium, wpn_neostead, wpn_mp7_silencer_special) without their default modifications (reload time, reliability, accuracy and the like; the silver bonus 1230 now the item's own modification) and base_rarity_level 3 -> 0 (resources.db patch, content-edit golden-weapons-1); death poses 1: the face-down death pose out of the rifles' and pistols' death animations, the death animation picked among the rest (rifles 2 of 4, pistols 1 of 2; the pick, a random of the player's state, maps to other animations) (resources.db patch, content-edit death-poses-1)

battery modes respawn 10 s: gameplay/game_modes/*.options mode/parameters/respawn_time 8 -> 10 in every config of modes 2 and 3 (Protective device, Protective device: chargers), Team Deathmatch unchanged (resources.db patch, content-edit battery-respawn-1); v0.11 maps spawn protection 6 s: projects/v011e_level_03 and v011e_level_04 (day_2, day_4) client_project server_objects/respawn_points[*]/invulnerability_time 2 -> 6 on all 174 respawn points (resources.db patch, content-edit v011e-spawn-protection-1)

Research, mode 5: exe patch 53 (the research rule, class 0x1E0) and its 25 maps (resources.db patch, pack research-mode@3): a game without the patch cannot load a mode-5 map (#297); the artefacts (the owner, 2026-10-22): exe patch 54 (a Spring takes aim time from its config in its passive and active, and bullets do not slow its active's holder, a Lifebone's active fills pain, body and head, one press fires every ready artefact of its kind) and content-edit artefacts-1 (Spring passive movement 0.02 -> 0.05, aim time -0.05 passive and -0.1 active, active stopping_power_mod -1; Lifebone timeout_add 2 -> 0 in its seven regeneration modifiers) (resources.db patch) (#308)

Larkspur (Lifebone) cooldown 45 s (the owner, 2026-10-23): gameplay/items/artefacts/artefact_lifebone.options data/cooldown_sec 15 -> 45, its active fully restoring body, head and pain since revision 30 (resources.db patch, content-edit artefacts-1) (#340); Research statistics (exe patch 53): a capture, a neutralisation and a kill invader counted in the player's own kit cell of events 6, 18 and 10 (revision 30 wrote them 4 bytes on: kit 1 and 2 into events 7, 19 and 11), and the score told at once (#352)

the bandage buff (the owner, 2026-10-24): gameplay/items/drugs/bandages.options data/influences hands and legs 0.3 -> 1 per second, new influences body 0.35, head 0.14, pain 0.35 per second for its 1 s (hands and legs full, pain, body and head 35 %) (resources.db patch, content-edit bandages-1); the Onyx nerf (the owner, 2026-10-25): active damage and piercing x0.1 -> x0.4 (gameplay/items/artefacts/artefact_onyx.options data/active/damage_mul and armor_piercing_mul, resources.db patch, content-edit artefacts-1) and exe patch 54: n Onyx fired by one press each active 3 s + (n - 1) s, several active Onyx reducing a hit once (the first active one of the slots), was x0.1 for each (#408); the Onyx buff to 75 % (the owner, 2026-10-25): active damage and piercing x0.4 -> x0.25 (artefact_onyx.options data/active/damage_mul and armor_piercing_mul, resources.db patch, content-edit artefacts-1), its stacking as #408 (#423)

the SOCOM 16 nerf (the owner, 2026-10-25): gameplay/items/weapons/wpn_socom16.options parameters/bullet_damage 0.7 -> 0.6, bullet_pierce 0.45 -> 0.4, item_level and match_making_level 12 -> 15 (resources.db patch, content-edit socom-nerf-1) (#443); fall speed (the owner, 2026-10-25): exe patch 72, step_down's free fall takes gravity for the step's dt, g x min(dt, 0.05), not a whole tick at every step: a tick the world steps in parts (each precise input, a change of the fire bit) gave a falling player one tick of speed per part, and the landing hurt as from a higher fall; whole ticks unchanged, bit for bit (#444)

London without anomalies and with the owner's map-editor spawns (PR #439): projects/level_09/day_2 to day_5 lose their seven anomalies and artefacts, battery modes lose the old spawn-protection zones, and all modes keep 10 points per team at the new first-floor positions (content-edit london-1)

weapon rolls take effect (the owner, 2026-10-29): the recoil modifications 2080-2084 (-2..-10 %) and defect 3060 (+10 %) scale the six kick keys the recoil loader 0x331840 reads (recoil/min and max_top, _left, _right_recoil x max(0, 1 + sum)), where they targeted first/queue-shoot keys no 0.26g weapon has and did nothing; the aim-time modifications 2070-2074 (-2..-10 %, the VSSK camo's default 2074 too) scale the weapon's parameters/aim_time (type 2), where they targeted a player modifier a weapon never registers (resources.db patch, content-edit weapon-rolls-1) (#745); built-in bonuses at the second-strongest strength (the owner, 2026-10-29; content-edit built-in-bonuses-1): every equipment item's default of a kind that rolls raised to that kind's second-strongest row, never lowered (53 items, 55 defaults, e.g. movement speed +4 %, energy costs -8 %, regeneration +12 %); then the exoskeleton suits (exo-suits-buff-1): freedom_exo_026 stamina regeneration +8 % (1103) added, duty_exo_026 weight limit +5 kg (1124) and regeneration +15 % (1094) added; Artefact carry: deterministic quick-slot offer commands, carry snapshots and action suppression; Use transfers a teammate's offered passive artefact into a free container within reach and line of sight; damage collision arm bones follow the eye-relative right-palm pose and respect native computed-bone layers; changing offered artefacts lowers the current item before raising the queued item, with both phases snapshotted; death drops the carried item with synchronized falling position, and Use picks it up from the ground into a free container (#751)
